dogecoin.text: What's with all the hate for #Dogecoin during dips? Do other people shit all over BTC or others when they dip? The amount of sheer hate this coin generates from "opposition" is astounding and an interesting study. Like... why??
My husband always wants to pull out. I always want him to stay in. It always causes the cutest arguments. (Talking about Crypto dips you freaks.) #dogecoin #safemoon
